commands.name: spec-typecheck
commands.run: quint typecheck spec/quint/billing_sync.qnt && quint typecheck spec/quint/billing_sync_2ev.qnt && quint typecheck spec/quint/cart_ops.qnt

commands.name: spec-sim
commands.run: for i in convPayloadAtomic convFetchLwwAtomic convFetchGuardAtomic convFetchTieAtomic convPayloadKv convFetchGuardKv convFetchTieKv neverAhead; do echo ===$i; quint run spec/quint/billing_sync_2ev.qnt --invariant=$i --max-steps=12 --max-samples=20000 2>&1 | grep -E 'violation|No violation'; done

commands.name: spec-verify
commands.run: for i in convPayloadAtomic convFetchLwwAtomic convFetchGuardAtomic convFetchTieAtomic convPayloadKv convFetchGuardKv convFetchTieKv neverAhead; do echo ===$i; quint verify spec/quint/billing_sync_2ev.qnt --invariant=$i --max-steps=12 2>&1 | tail -2; done

commands.name: spec-alloy
commands.run: java -jar ~/tools/alloy.jar exec spec/alloy/billing_link.als && java -jar ~/tools/alloy.jar exec spec/alloy/cart_link.als

commands.name: spec-ec-sim
commands.run: for i in divergenceOnlyPending deletesOnlySnapshotted chargesOnlyVisible fulfilledExactlyCharged noStaleCharge noPostSnapWriteLoss noExpiryCharge; do echo ===$i; quint run spec/quint/cart_ops.qnt --invariant=$i --max-steps=15 --max-samples=30000 2>&1 | grep -E 'violation|No violation'; done

commands.name: spec-ec-verify
commands.run: for i in divergenceOnlyPending deletesOnlySnapshotted chargesOnlyVisible fulfilledExactlyCharged noStaleCharge noPostSnapWriteLoss noExpiryCharge; do echo ===$i; quint verify spec/quint/cart_ops.qnt --invariant=$i --max-steps=8 2>&1 | tail -2; done
